No snooze. Rings until you finish. Checks you\'re still up a few minutes later. Comes back if you restart the phone.
Hard, with two checks and the strictest limits.

resources.string: No snooze and the loudest sound, with Extra loud. Two checks after you\'re up. The way out without the mission opens only after 10 minutes of ringing and takes 20 tasks. You can\'t change this alarm in the 12 hours before it rings. Emergency calls always work.
Now Normal: an alarm with a mission is Normal or harder.
Now Easy: there is no mission left.
%1$s needs a mission. Pick Normal or Easy first to remove the last one.
Easy has no mission: picking it puts this alarm\'s missions aside. Pick another level to get them back.
Volume, snooze, stopping, coming back, checks and rules
Rings at whatever the phone\'s alarm volume is set to.
Sets the phone\'s alarm volume while it rings, then puts it back.
Get louder if I ignore it
After 40 seconds without a touch it adds an intense layer and turns up.
Once it got louder, touching the screen is not enough to calm it.
Don\'t let the volume go below
Turning the alarm volume down while it rings doesn\'t stick.
Not Bluetooth speakers or earbuds, unless they are wired in.
Keep ringing until I finish the mission
Without a mission: until I stop or snooze it.
For the morning the mission can\'t be done. Always recorded as an emergency stop.
If the phone can\'t do the mission
No camera, a sensor that stopped: easy tasks replace it. It is never skipped.
Ring again later if it stopped
If it stopped by itself, it rings again, louder.
If I try to get out of it
Bring the alarm back if I leave it
Leaving the alarm screen is allowed. The alarm keeps ringing.
If I leave it, a notification alerts me again every 20 s.
If I leave it, the alarm screen comes back after a second. Needs "Display over other apps".
Ring again after a restart, for up to
If the phone is restarted while it rings, it rings again within this time, at full volume.
Can\'t change this alarm in the
… before it rings. Switching it off counts as a change.
Unlock it early with its own mission
Instead of a few sums. Not while it rings or is snoozed.
After you stop the alarm, it asks again a few minutes later and rings if you don\'t answer.
One round of Focus Tap, no button. Walking 30 steps also counts.
New: choose how hard each alarm is
Open an alarm and pick Easy, Normal, Hard or No mercy. Your alarms ring as before until you change them.
Always on at Normal and harder.
